script.narration: He pledged to raise a new elite force, the Trifarian Legion, made up of the most loyal and prestigious warriors the empire could produce.

script.narration: With them at his back, he would lead the armies of Noxus into a glorious new age of conquest.

script.narration: From a starving orphan in the alleys of Basilich to one of the three rulers of Noxus, Darius never changed what he believed in.

script.narration: Strength is earned, never inherited. And a single soldier who refuses to step back can change the fate of an entire empire.

script.narration: As Darius himself would say: history only remembers the victors. Stand with Noxus, and be remembered forever.
